verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes Asana *publishing* its own MCP server (asana-docs-34–42) and being consumed by AI assistants like Claude/ChatGPT (asana-docs-38 'mcp-clients'), not Asana itself ingesting/plugging in third-party MCP servers so its own AI Teammates or workflows can call their tools. No evidence shows Asana acting as an MCP client that connects to arbitrary external MCP servers.
